verdict.rationale: Groq's model catalog includes recent open-weight releases such as OpenAI's GPT-OSS 120B. A community user also reports that Groq hosted Kimi K2 at a time when it was the only fast provider, which hints at early availability. However, no first-party documentation describes how quickly new models are onboarded. Another community comment says new models moved to 'call us for quotes', which may limit self-serve access to fresh releases. Missing for 10: documented time-to-availability or release-day support, a changelog or model-onboarding policy, independent corroboration of fast onboarding, and confirmation that new models are self-serve.
